skills.skill_desc:
Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 <font color="a6aafb">Oath Keeper</font> energy each time they deal damage to targets. When the energy reaches 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100<font color="ffe63c"> (+10*Hero Level)</font><font color="26e407"> (+15% Extra Max HP)</font> HP.
Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage.
<font color="a6aafb">Mounted State</font>: Each <font color="a6aafb">Oath Keeper</font> energy gain is increased by 200%.

Leomord begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit (scales with channeling time; increased to 140% against creeps except the Turtle and Lord) and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Cast the skill again to cancel the channeling and immediately perform the thrust.

Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

Leomord summons <font color="a6aafb">Barbiel</font> to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in its path.
If <font color="a6aafb">Barbiel</font> comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.
<font color="a6aafb">Mounted State</font>: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 70 Movement Speed and 30 <font color="26e407"><1999></font>. This lasts 10s.
